title: TopoCryptoEEG: End-to-End Encrypted Framework for Brainprint Authentication
abstract: arXiv:2611.31801v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Brainprint authentication enables continuous identity verification, but EEG data are privacy-sensitive. Existing feature-level encrypted authentication (FLEA) schemes protect extracted features under a trusted-client assumption. We show theoretically and empirically that a compromised client with access to plaintext query features and continuous authentication scores can exactly recover a registered template after finitely many interactions. To address this risk, we propose TopoCryptoEEG, a homomorphic-encryption-based framework that encrypts preprocessed EEG data at the client and performs feature extraction, template matching, score computation, and threshold centering on ciphertexts at the server. This extends protection from extracted features to preprocessed EEG data and removes the client-side plaintext-feature interface exploited by the attack. translated_title: TopoCryptoEEG：用于脑纹认证的端到端加密框架
translated_abstract: 脑纹（brainprint）认证能够实现持续的身份验证，但脑电（EEG）数据具有隐私敏感性。现有的特征级加密认证（FLEA）方案是在“可信客户端”假设下保护提取的特征。我们从理论和实证两方面证明：一个被攻破的客户端若能获取明文查询特征和持续认证分数，在有限次交互后即可精确恢复已注册的模板。为应对这一风险，我们提出了TopoCryptoEEG，这是一个基于同态加密的框架，它在客户端对预处理的脑电数据进行加密，并在服务器端对密文执行特征提取、模板匹配、分数计算和阈值居中。这将保护范围从提取的特征扩展到预处理的脑电数据，并消除了攻击所利用的客户端明文特征接口。为实现高效的加密认证，我们开发了多窗口拓扑感知编码……
tldr: 该论文揭示了现有特征级加密脑纹认证方案存在漏洞——被攻破的客户端可在有限次交互后精确恢复注册模板，并提出基于同态加密的TopoCryptoEEG框架，在客户端加密预处理脑电数据、在服务器端对密文完成全部认证流程，从而将保护范围扩展至预处理数据并彻底消除明文特征接口。
en_tdlr: The paper reveals a vulnerability in existing feature-level encrypted brainprint authentication—where a compromised client can exactly recover the registered template after finitely many interactions—and proposes TopoCryptoEEG, a homomorphic-encryption framework that encrypts preprocessed EEG data at the client and performs the entire authentication pipeline on ciphertexts at the server.
